warnings.detail: Adviser transaction report (not a statement) — MOPWM's family-wide record of dated trades, READ PERFECTLY and deliberately not a statement source: no custodian or fund struck it, and it prints no holding, valuation or ISIN. `build-book` reads it for one licensed use, exact cost recovery (`scripts/lib/mopwmTransactions.mjs`, docs/COST-RECOVERY.md): a holding whose statement prints no cost takes the cost of the lots these rows leave only where owner, security, account and every unit reconcile on the statement's own date.
